subject: Small login thing - maybe already okay
text:
Hi there,

Sorry if this is scattered, but I need help with something technical before it gets confusing.

The login screen kept rejecting the project code I received, then my session expired twice in one minute. I tried mobile too, and the panel stayed blank, so I returned to desktop.

Strangely, after all that, the dashboard loaded with every file already synced, including the one I thought was missing. Should I still submit a ticket, or was that just a brief hiccup today?

Thanks,
Alex
